decision: Separate exchange-labeled XRP balances into native customer custody, cold storage, wrapped-token backing reserves, insurance/charity funds, operational reserves and unknown/unclassified wallets before estimating float or venue liquidity.
rationale: The 22.58B XRP public exchange-wallet total includes at least 488.4M XRP identified as wrapped-asset backing or insurance/charity funds. Coinbase's official cbXRP reserve/supply dashboard independently confirms approximately 151.4M XRP backing Base cbXRP; Binance's historical XRP-BF2 announcement confirms 1:1 native backing but current reserve quantity remains secondary.
feature_policy: Do not use broad exchange-labeled balances as tradable float. Exclude known wrapped reserves from customer-deposit estimates, but retain them as custodial/bridge collateral and as potential redemption/operational flows. Keep cold storage and customer liabilities separate. No XRP price feature admitted.
unresolved: Crosswalk five Binance compromised XRPL source wallets to the XRP-BF2 reserve address and Coinbase cbXRP reserve wallet set; obtain current official Binance XRP-BF2 balance and refreshed Coinbase cbXRP snapshot after the incident.
